units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:2:5">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>פסל לך שתהא הפ׳ שלך</he> ‘hew for thyself’ (<cite ref="Exodus 34:1">Ex. XXXIV, 1</cite>) that the chips be thine; <cite ref="Nedarim 38a:3">Ned. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>פְּסוֹלְתָּן שלך</he> their chips be thine.
<cite ref="Nedarim 38a:3">Ib.</cite>; Y. Shek. l. c. <he>מפ׳ של לוחית העשיר וכ׳</he> Moses became rich from the chips of the tablets; a. e.
<cite ref="Shabbat 138a:10">Sabb. 138ᵃ</cite> <he>נוטל אוכל ומניח את הפ׳</he> he takes up what is eatable, and leaves the refuse.
<cite ref="Shabbat 138a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ למעלה וכ׳</he> (when you sift,) the refuse is on the surface, and the eatable peas are at the bottom.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16">Num. R. s. 16</cite> <he>שהפ׳ שלה משובח וכ׳</he> the inferior soil of Palestine was much superior to the best of &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:12">Ib.</cite> <he>שכן התגרין מראין את הפ׳ וכ׳</he> so the merchants show the inferior goods first &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:4:4">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <he>מקצות</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 12:31">I Kings XII, 31</cite>) <he>מן הקוצים שבעם ומן הפ׳ וכ׳</he> of the thorns among the people, the refuse &c.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 312:1">Sifré Deut. 312</cite> <he>יצא ממנו פ׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="G00723"><he>זרע</he></cite>) unworthy offspring came from him; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּסוֹלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="O01244"><he>סָנַן</he></cite>.
